usage: The word '酒店' (zau2 dim3) is used as a noun referring to a hotel or place to stay overnight.
It is commonly placed after a location or brand name to specify the hotel, like '尖沙咀酒店' (Tsim Sha Tsui hotel).
You can use it as the object in a sentence, for example, when booking or asking about accommodations.
It functions as a countable noun, so you can say '一間酒店' (one hotel).
The word can also be used in compound phrases like '酒店服務' meaning hotel services.
